models.resource: A digital tool or platform the school uses, displayed as a card with a link. Each resource has an audience (Students, Parents, Staff, or All) and a category.
models.calendarEntry: A key academic date or event such as a term start, holiday, or examination period, shown in a structured list.

relationships: Resources are filtered by audience on the Media page
CalendarEntries are displayed in chronological order and are independent of resources

resources.title: Google Classroom
resources.description: Access your class assignments, submit work, and communicate with teachers through the school's learning management system.

resources.title: Student Results Portal
resources.description: View term-end report cards, exam scores, and academic progress summaries for current and past sessions.

resources.title: Parent Dashboard
resources.description: Monitor your child's attendance, academic performance, fee payment status, and receive school notifications.

resources.title: Fee Payment Portal
resources.description: Pay school fees securely online using bank transfer, card, or USSD. Download receipts and view payment history.

resources.title: Digital Library
resources.description: Browse and borrow from thousands of e-books, academic journals, and reference materials available 24/7.

resources.title: Staff Portal
resources.description: Internal platform for staff to manage class registers, submit grades, access HR documents, and view announcements.

resources.title: School Email (Google Workspace)
resources.description: Access your official school email address and Google Drive for school communications and document collaboration.

resources.title: CBT Examination Platform
resources.description: The school's Computer-Based Testing platform used for internal assessments, mock exams, and practice tests.

resources.title: School Notice Board
resources.description: Stay up to date with the latest school announcements, circulars, and official notices published by the administration.

calendarEntries.title: Second Term Begins
calendarEntries.description: Students resume for the second term of the 2024/2025 academic session.

calendarEntries.title: Mock WAEC Examinations
calendarEntries.description: Internal mock examinations for SSS 3 students in preparation for WAEC.

calendarEntries.title: Mid-Term Break
calendarEntries.description: One-week mid-term break for all students.

calendarEntries.title: Parents' Visiting Day
calendarEntries.description: Annual parents' day — parents are invited to meet teachers and review progress reports.

calendarEntries.title: Second Term Ends
calendarEntries.description: Last day of the second term. Long vacation begins.

calendarEntries.title: Third Term Begins
calendarEntries.description: Students resume for the third and final term of the 2024/2025 session.

calendarEntries.title: WAEC/NECO Examinations Begin
calendarEntries.description: West African Senior School Certificate Examination (WASSCE) for SSS 3 students.

calendarEntries.title: Annual Sports Day
calendarEntries.description: Inter-house sports competition held on the school field. All students participate.

calendarEntries.title: Graduation & Prize Giving Ceremony
calendarEntries.description: Annual graduation ceremony for the SSS 3 graduating class.

calendarEntries.title: Third Term Ends — Long Vacation
calendarEntries.description: End of the 2024/2025 academic session. Long vacation begins.
